newsitem.title: UK: BOE's Price joins IBCA to head sovereign ratings.
newsitem.headline: BOE's Price joins IBCA to head sovereign ratings.

text.p: IBCA, the European rating agency, said on Thursday it had appointed Lionel Price as a director of the sovereign ratings department of the agency.
IBCA said in a statement that Price would provide essential management support for the fastest-expanding part of IBCA's business.
IBCA said the growth of international capital flows and of investors' appetite for emerging markets risk means that the agency expects a steady expansion over the next few years.

Price joins IBCA from the Bank of England, where he was the director of the Centre for Central Banking Studies and has been involved in advising and teaching good central bank practice to many new central bankers in the transition economies of central and eastern europe.
